title: HOSPES Show DNA
description: Schema for a single show's identity, format engine, host functions, editorial constraints, visual/audio rules, release strategy, advertising policy, asset requirements, voice persona, and relationship governance.

id.description: Stable machine-readable identifier. Used as show_id throughout the OS.

primary_format.description: One-sentence statement of the format contract (e.g. video-native that remains complete as audio).

recording_cities.description: Cities where episodes may be recorded.

audience_promise.description: The editorial contract with the audience — what every episode must deliver.

format_engine.description: The episode structure expressed as fixed (every episode) and rotating (selected per guest) segments.

engine_label.description: Short mnemonic for the format engine (e.g. 'Claim → Stress Test → Artifact').

fixed.description: Segments that appear in every episode, in order.

rotating.description: Segments chosen per episode based on guest and editorial fit.

selection_rubric.description: Criteria a rotating segment must satisfy to be selected.

host_functions.description: Per-host role definitions. Keys are host identifiers (e.g. 'ari', 'anthony'). At least one host required.

function.description: Comma-separated list of the host's editorial role attributes.

contrast_note.description: Optional note on how this host contrasts with the other host(s).

required_work.description: Actions this host must personally perform — their irreducible human seat.

prohibited_work.description: Work the system takes over so this host never has to do it.

operational_budget.description: Target weekly time budget expressed as a plain statement (e.g. 'approximately 10 minutes per week').

editorial_exclusions.description: Absolute prohibitions for this show. Nothing on this list may appear in any episode.

visual_rule.description: Governing visual doctrine for this show.

doctrine.description: The core visual rule in one or two sentences.

camera_grammar.description: Named camera angles/roles in order of hierarchy.

evolution_path.description: Versioned upgrade path for the visual package.

field_notes.description: Optional notes specific to field/location recording contexts.

audio_rule.description: Audio capture doctrine for this show.

doctrine.description: Core audio philosophy in one sentence.

required_tracks.description: Audio tracks that must be captured for every recording.

sync_protocol.description: Synchronization method (e.g. 'synchronization slate at start and after interruptions').

bank_before_launch.description: Number of finished episodes to hold before any public release.

launch_drop.description: Number of episodes to release simultaneously at launch.

initial_goal.description: The primary success criterion for the launch phase.

ad_rules.description: Advertising policy and available formats for this show.

philosophy.description: The governing principle for all advertising on this show.

house_ads_first.description: If true, house/owned-project ads precede any paid sponsor placement.

production_rules.description: Mandatory production and disclosure rules for all ads.

sponsor_intake_requirements.description: Fields every sponsor brief must contain before creative work begins.

asset_requirements.description: Assets that must be produced for every episode.

voice.description: Outreach and editorial voice persona references for this show.

show_persona.description: Brief statement of the show's voice personality as it appears in all outreach and editorial copy.

tone_words.description: Keywords that characterize the show's tone.

outreach_voice_ref.description: Reference to an outreach-voice file or template set.

prohibited_tones.description: Tones and postures explicitly banned from outreach and editorial copy.

relationship_rules.description: Relationship class governance and social-cost routing doctrine for this show.

classes_honored.description: Relationship classes recognized by this show (must match the global graph's class vocabulary).

protected_relationship_rule.description: Policy governing contacts in the highest-trust class.

routing_principle.description: Decision rule for choosing contact routes (e.g. 'least socially expensive credible route').

auto_outreach_block.description: If true, the system never sends outreach from personal accounts without explicit human approval.

mass_outreach_ban.description: If true, mass or bulk outreach is prohibited regardless of channel.
